messages:
maria: Heads-up: promote job for v2.14.0 is blocked, canary failed during deployment.
ci-bot: CI pipeline #4821 reported failure in canary stage for service/router (canary=5%).
ci-bot: Failed step: deploy-canary -> exit code 1
maria: logs show the helm chart rendered an image reference that points to a symlinked tag that doesn't exist in registry.
maria: error snippet:
```
Error: failed to pull image "gcr.io/redwood/router:release-latest -> release-2026-03-18": manifest unknown: Failed to fetch manifest from .../release-2026-03-18
```
jamal: that -> in the chart values we dynamically set image.tag to `{{ .Values.image.symlink }}`. looks like the symlink promotion job didn't update the registry tag
olivia: also seeing build cache lock in the logs earlier: `failed to acquire layer lock: resource busy` — might be the artifact promotion step still holding the GCR monolith lock
build-bot: note: promotion job #879 is still in progress (stuck at blob mount), attempting retry count 3/5
maria: so two failures: promo job stuck (cache/blob mount) + helm rendered missing manifest -> canary fails
aj: suggestion: roll back to pinned image `router:2026-03-17-9f5a` for this release to unblock promotion window. then investigate symlink job separately
maria: +1 for pinned image for emergency promotion. but need approvals for out-of-band pin in change window.
jamal: can we re-run artifact promote after forcing the blob mount to timeout? Ops can trigger a force-unlock on the registry side (needs infra approval)
olivia: ops is OOO until 14:00 PT. change window ends 15:00 PT. if we wait it'll miss promo SLA
maria: deploy-bot: set release hold and notify owners
deploy-bot: Release v2.14.0 status: ON_HOLD (reason: canary failure). Blocking actions: [promote-artifact, canary-rollout].
aj: plan: 1) pin and trigger a canary deploy to confirm pin is fine 2) if green, manual promote artifact 3) postmortem for symlink/promote race
maria: I'll open a hotfix branch and push the pin. tagging @oncall @security for registry unlock if needed.
jamal: I'll try a manual `gcr` blob remount hack now (will post results). if it doesn't succeed, we do pin.
build-bot: retry scheduled in 2m (attempt 4) for promotion job #879
ci-bot: canary redeploy started for router@router:2026-03-17-9f5a
maria: thanks. if the redeploy succeeds, we can proceed with manual promote and document the out-of-band pin in release notes and changelog. will record rollover decision in the release thread.
aj: one more: add a guard in the CD pipeline to fail early if image symlink resolves to a non-existent manifest (pre-deploy check). saves us wasted canary runs.
olivia: agreed. I'll open a ticket for the preflight check and add a small PR to helm-templater to validate images.
maria: ok locking in immediate action: pin + manual promote if canary green. holding release until manual confirmation. will update channel when promote completes.
ci-bot: promotion job #879 attempt 4 -> FAILED: blob mount timeout
jamal: manual blob remount failed. proceeding with pin path now.
maria: pinned commit pushed to hotfix/pin-router-2026-03-17, triggered canary. monitoring.
ci-bot: canary for router@2026-03-17-9f5a -> SUCCESS (5/5 checks)
maria: canary looks good. proceeding with manual artifact promote and then final promote steps. tagging release manager @aj for approval.
aj: approving manual promote. do it now.
build-bot: manual promote triggered by @aj. artifact promotion completed successfully.
maria: promoted. releasing v2.14.0 with pinned router image. document: release note will include reason for pin: registry symlink promotion race -> temporary pin to 2026-03-17-9f5a. follow-up ticket: INFRA-1293 (registry lock/stale-symlink), assigned to olivia & jamal.
olivia: opening INFRA-1293 now, adding timeline and logs.
maria: thanks all. ending hold and updating release board. will schedule retro tomorrow post-change window. :white_check_mark:
